stem: Patient with trauma to the thigh about 4cm with visible underline tissues and bone. What is the initial treatment?
OptC: IV antibiotics within the first hour ??
OptD: Immediate surgical debridement and stabilization Discuss with us: https://t.me/Saudi_SMLE_TOP10/43406 Needs a double check ATLS , Standard trauma sequence: 1. Primary survey (ABCDE) 2. Start IV broad-spectrum antibiotics immediately 3. Tetanus prophylaxis 4. Sterile dressing and immobilization 5. Urgent surgical debridement and fixation ● States that early IV antibiotics are essential in all open fractures to reduce infection risk. ● Antibiotics should be given as soon as possible after diagnosis, ideally within 1 hour. ● After that: sterile dressing, splinting, tetanus prophylaxis, then urgent surgical irrigation and debridement. ● Emphasizes that the most important early intervention in open fractures is prompt administration of IV antibiotics. ● Surgical irrigation and debridement follow after initial stabilization. ● Recommends immediate IV antibiotics upon diagnosis of an open fracture, followed by operative debridement and stabilization. If the question asks “initial management of open fracture” ➡IV antibiotics If the question asks “definitive management” ➡Surgical irrigation, debridement, and stabilization
